```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(ChAMP)

source("../../../Utils/LOLA_two_sided.R")

```

# Analysis

Here I load the list of differentially methylated CpGs and perform LOLA distinguishing between hyper- and hypomethylated CpGs. All CpGs after initial filtering will be used as the universe.   

```{r}
load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_annotated.RData") )
myNorm_anno_sorted <- readRDS(file.path(data_storage_folder, "myNorm_GSE210994_anno_sorted.rds") )

anno = myNorm_anno_sorted[, c("CHR","MAPINFO")]
```

```{r}
load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "Methylation_DM_lists_IM_vs _NonIM_and_vs_healthy.Rdata"))
```


```{r}
# uu=0, um=1, mm=2
#baseline <- readRDS("../../../../Data/Processed/WGBS/WGS_Cpg_Meth_classes_EPIC.rds")
baseline <- readRDS("../../../../Data/Processed/CpG_classifications_u.m_EPIC_and_WGS.rds")

baseline_uu <- subset(baseline, !is.na(Antrum_EPIC) & Antrum_EPIC == "uu")$ID
baseline_mm <- subset(baseline, !is.na(Antrum_EPIC) & Antrum_EPIC == "mm")$ID
na = subset(baseline, is.na(Antrum_EPIC))$ID

# only non-mm CpGs in StoAntrum can be relatively hypermethylated in other tissues
# vice versa for non-uu CpGs and hypomethylated CpGs 
# define universes accordingly
universe_hyper = with(subset(anno, !rownames(anno)  %in% baseline_mm), GRanges(as.character(CHR), IRanges(start = MAPINFO, end = MAPINFO)) )

universe_hypo = with(subset(anno, !rownames(anno) %in% baseline_uu), GRanges(as.character(CHR), IRanges(start = MAPINFO, end = MAPINFO)) )
```


# Enrichment of DM genes in functional / genomic categories

```{r, warning=F, message=F}
all_comparisons = list()

for (nn in names(all_hyper_cpg)) {
  hyper_cpg = subset(all_hyper_cpg[[nn]], !Row.names %in% baseline_mm)
  hypo_cpg = subset(all_hypo_cpg[[nn]], !Row.names %in% baseline_uu)

  all_comparisons[[paste(nn, "hyper", sep="_")]] = merge(hyper_cpg, anno, by.x="Row.names", by.y=0)
  all_comparisons[[paste(nn, "hypo", sep="_")]] = merge(hypo_cpg, anno, by.x="Row.names", by.y=0)

}

all_comparisons = all_comparisons[sapply(all_comparisons, function(x) dim(x)[1]) > 0]

GRanges_fun = function(x){
  GRanges(as.character(x$CHR), IRanges(start = x$MAPINFO, end = x$MAPINFO))
}

all_comparisons_GRanges = lapply(all_comparisons, GRanges_fun)
```


```{r}
# taken from Somatic Signatures
ucsc <- function(x) {
    suppressMessages(seqlevelsStyle(x) <- "UCSC") ## '<-' needed
    genome(x) = NA ## avoid mismatches in 'genome' slots for overlaps
    return(x)
}
```




## LOLA extended

We here run the LOLA analysis with "Cgs" as the query data set, "universe" as universe and the LOLA extended data base.

```{r, warning=F, message=F}
dbPath = "../../../../Data/ExtData/LOLA/regions/LOLAExt/hg19"
regionDB = loadRegionDB(dbPath, useCache = T)
```

```{r}
computeLOLA <- function(x, regionDB, baseline="hyper") {
  if(baseline=="hyper") {
    runLOLA(ucsc(x), ucsc(universe_hyper), regionDB, cores=12)
  } else {
    runLOLA(ucsc(x), ucsc(universe_hypo), regionDB, cores=12)
  }
}
```


```{r,  warning=TRUE, message=FALSE}
if(TRUE){

output_file_prefix = paste(result_folder,"LOLA_Ext_results_baseline_filtered_", sep="/")

all_results_lola = list()
for (bb in names(all_comparisons_GRanges)) {
     xx = all_comparisons_GRanges[[bb]]
     
     if(grepl("_hyper", bb)) baseline="hyper" else baseline = "hypo"
     
     res = computeLOLA(xx, regionDB, baseline)
     res$p.adj = p.adjust(10^(-res$pValueLog), method="BH")
    
     all_results_lola[[paste(bb,sep="_")]] = res

     write.table(all_results_lola[[bb]], file=paste(output_file_prefix, bb, ".txt", sep="" ), row.names=F , sep="\t", dec=".")
}

save(all_results_lola, file= file.path(data_storage_folder, "LOLA_Ext_results_baseline_filtered.Rdata"))

}else{
  load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "LOLA_Ext_results_baseline_filtered.Rdata"))
}
```

## LOLA custom Hpy

We here run the LOLA analysis with "Cgs" as the query data set, "universe" as universe and a custom LOLA data base containing genes DE after Hpy infection.

```{r, warning=F, message=F}
dbPath = "../../../../Data/ExtData/LOLA/custom/hg19"
regionDB = loadRegionDB(dbPath, useCache = F)
```

